Native lyrics page displays loading while the request is in flight
Opening/loading lyrics never pauses or restarts native music
Matched source text becomes actual native lyric views

Touching a timed native line seeks the real MediaPlayer
Playback position highlights the current genuine timed line

A lyric network error leaves audio playing
A successful empty provider response clears stale lines

Different-version written text has no seek action or synthetic synchronization

Manual lookup identity survives repository recreation for that recording
Lyrics metadata correction never changes the playing track's real metadata
